weightValidation.varianceTolerances: Tonnage variance thresholds enforced with automated exception tagging
weightValidation.netVarianceCalculation: destNet - originNet computed with zero client tampering

fieldOperations.tripLifecycleTransitions: Strict state machine validation (DRAFT -> LOADED -> IN_TRANSIT -> COMPLETED / RETURNED / EXCEPTION)

entityResolution.relationshipValidation: Truck-to-Carrier and Driver-to-Carrier mappings verified against master data

offlineAndSynchronization.outboxQueue: Transactional queue with unique operationId and deviceId tracking

responsiveUXAndDirectionality.directionalitySupport: Dynamic RTL/LTR container mirroring based on active locale
